findings_qualitative.value: Six mm cores and nine radio components reveal an eleven-member protocluster; MM2/R1 drives an ionized jet and collimated outflow

evidence.quote: At higher resolution an additional collimated, bipolar outflow in the south-east and north-west direction is detected likely powered by MM2.

claims.experiment: Cross-identification of radio and ALMA mm sources
claims.result: Six mm cores plus radio components, eleven members
claims.finding: Protocluster with sources in different evolutionary phases

evidence.quote: the picture of a protocluster with multiple (eleven) members is clearly perceivable
towards MM6 show a clear inverse P-Cygni profile which is a signature of protostellar infall.

claims.finding: Consistent with hot cores especially MM1-MM4

evidence.quote: The estimated values for cores associated with G19.88-0.53 indicates the origin of the $\rm CH_3OH$ emission from hot cores, especially for MM1 to MM4.

limitations_admitted.value: Radio components may be knots of a single jet so member count may be lower

evidence.quote: then the number of distinct members of the detected protocluster would be less than eleven
